_partNote: Class images for the explorer tiles, rendered at about 74px. Following the rule in CLAUDE.md: one bold centered object per prompt, static or a single simple contact, no cutaways, no convergence, no beams meeting anything. Optics is the hardest sheet for this, because most of its subjects are small featureless cylinders and glass discs, so the seven silhouettes are chosen for outline instead: a finned laser head, a bare bulb-shaped emitter on a star board, a thick biconvex lens standing in a mount, a knurled cylinder with a window, a small square die on a header with a domed window, a compound microscope body, and a flat chip carrying a fan of waveguides.
style: Minimalist technical illustration, the style of a precise patent drawing crossed with an isometric product sketch. Uniform-weight dark slate-gray ink linework with sparse, muted steel-blue accent shading (hex 4E7AA8) on a plain very light warm-gray background (hex F2F3F1). Three-quarter isometric view, single centered subject, generous margins. No text, no labels, no callouts, no logos, no humans, no background scenery, no drop shadows. Clean, engineered, calm. Strictly two colors plus the background: dark slate-gray line and muted steel-blue fill. Every material, including glass, metal and wire, is drawn in that same palette. Absolutely no copper, brass, bronze, gold, orange, red, yellow or green anywhere, even where the real object would be that color. No colored light, no rainbows, no glowing beams. Favor open, airy linework with large unfilled light areas over heavy solid gray shading; the drawing should read as line art, not as a rendered solid model. Draw the subject as one whole object seen from outside. Do not draw a cutaway, a section view or an exploded assembly.

partPrompts.1: An industrial laser head lying horizontally on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a stocky rectangular metal body covered along its top and sides with closely spaced straight cooling fins, a short plain cylindrical output snout projecting from the front face with a flat circular window in its end, and a single armored cable leaving the rear. Exterior view only. One object, no beam of light leaving it, no target, no bench, no optics table.
partPrompts.2: A high-power LED emitter on its board, lying flat and seen three-quarter: a small hexagonal metal-core circuit board with two flat solder pads at opposite corners, carrying at its center one square emitter chip under a smooth clear dome lens that swells up out of the board so the curve reads clearly in profile. Flat board, one bold dome. No light rays, no glow, no heatsink, no wires, no other components.
partPrompts.3: A single thick biconvex glass lens held upright in a ring mount, seen three-quarter: a plain cylindrical metal ring standing on a small flat base, with a round lens seated in it whose two curved faces bulge visibly out of either side of the ring so the lens shape reads in profile. The bulging glass profile is the whole point. One lens in one mount, no other optics, no beam, no rays, no bench.
partPrompts.4: A cylindrical opto-mechanical module standing upright on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a short thick metal barrel with a broad knurled band around its middle, a plain flat circular window recessed in the top face, a small round electrical connector on the side, and a flat mounting flange with two bolt holes at the base. Exterior view only, blank and instrument-like. One object, no light, no cables, no rays.
partPrompts.5: A packaged photodetector standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a small round metal can header with three straight pins projecting down from its base, topped by a clear domed window through which one flat square die is visible sitting centered on the header floor. The three long pins and the dome are the identifying shapes. One device, no circuit board, no cables, no light.
partPrompts.6: A compound optical microscope standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a heavy curved arm rising from a broad base, a stage plate partway up with a small round aperture, a turret at the top carrying three short objective barrels of different lengths pointing down, and a single angled eyepiece tube. Exterior view only, simple and blocky. One instrument, no sample, no light, no accessories.
partPrompts.7: A photonic chip lying flat on a surface, seen three-quarter: a thin rectangular die whose top face is etched with a bold fan of smooth curved waveguide lines that start close together at one edge and spread apart to the opposite edge, with a row of small square pads along one side. Flat and plate-like, with the fanned line pattern as the identifying feature. One die, no packaging, no fibers, no light, no probe needles.
